fields.doc: Date time this record was created.
fields.name: LASTCHANGED

fields.doc: Sum of PASAAVAILABILITY for all scheduled generating units and scheduled bidirectional units (Gen side) with a Recall_Period <= 24 hours plus the sum of Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecasts (UIGF) for all semi-scheduled generating units. For the OUTAGE_LRC run, UIGF is the POE90 forecast. For the LOR Run, UIGF is the POE50 forecast. Note that the OUTAGE_LRC Run Type is discontinued from 31 July 2025. From March 2026, AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY changes from that with Recall_Period <= 24 to that achievable by the relevant INTERVAL_DATETIME if recalled at the start of the run.
fields.name: AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY

fields.doc: Maximum Surplus Reserve (MW) evaluated for this region from LRC runs. This field is no longer populated.
fields.name: MAXSURPLUSRESERVE

fields.doc: Maximum Spare Capacity (MW) evaluated for this region. Calculated for each region in turn. This value reflects Regional LOR reserve.
fields.name: MAXSPARECAPACITY

fields.doc: Lack of Reserve Condition (LOR) flag for this region and interval   (3 = LOR3, 2 = LOR2, 1 = LOR1, 0 = No LOR)
fields.name: LORCONDITION

fields.doc: Sum of MAXAVAIL quantities offered by all Scheduled units and Availability of all semi-scheduled units limited by MAXAVAIL in a given Region for a given PERIODID
fields.name: AGGREGATECAPACITYAVAILABLE

fields.doc: Sum of  MAXAVAIL quantities bid by of all Scheduled Loads in a given Region for a given PERIODID.
fields.name: AGGREGATESCHEDULEDLOAD

fields.doc: Date time this record was created.
fields.name: LASTCHANGED

fields.doc: Sum of PASAAVAILABILITY for all scheduled generating units and scheduled bidirectional units (Gen side) with a Recall_Period <= 24 hours plus the sum of Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecasts (UIGF) for all semi-scheduled generating units. For the OUTAGE_LRC run, UIGF is the POE90 forecast. For the LOR Run, UIGF is the POE50 forecast. Note that the OUTAGE_LRC Run Type is discontinued from 31 July 2025. From March 2026, AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY changes from that with Recall_Period <= 24 to that achievable by the relevant INTERVAL_DATETIME if recalled at the start of the run.
fields.name: AGGREGATEPASAAVAILABILITY

fields.doc: Type of run. Values are OUTAGE_LRC and LOR. Note that the PDPASA OUTAGE_LRC Run Type is discontinued from 31 July 2025, with only the LOR Run Type reported.
fields.name: RUNTYPE

fields.doc: Energy (GWh) required for this energy block based on the 10% probability of exceedance demand. Listed in the first interval of the energy block
fields.name: ENERGYREQDEMAND10

fields.doc: Region Reserve Level for LOR1 used. Can be static value or calculated value if an interconnector is a credible contingency
fields.name: CALCULATEDLOR1LEVEL

fields.doc: Region Reserve Level for LOR2 used. Can be static value or calculated value if an interconnector is a credible contingency
fields.name: CALCULATEDLOR2LEVEL

fields.doc: Net interconnector flow from the region for this interval from the MSR assessment. This field is no longer populated.
fields.name: MSRNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY

fields.doc: Net interconnector flow from the region for this interval from the LOR assessment
fields.name: LORNETINTERCHANGEUNDERSCARCITY

fields.doc: Allowance made for non-scheduled generation in the demand forecast (MW).
fields.name: TOTALINTERMITTENTGENERATION

fields.doc: Sum of Cleared Scheduled generation, imported generation (at the region boundary) and allowances made for non-scheduled generation (MW).
fields.name: DEMAND_AND_NONSCHEDGEN

fields.doc: Regional aggregated Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast of Semi-scheduled generation (MW).
fields.name: UIGF

fields.doc: Constrained generation forecast (MW) for semi-scheduled units for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, semi-scheduled generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All run types (OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.
fields.name: SEMISCHEDULEDCAPACITY

fields.doc: Constrained generation forecast for semi-scheduled units for the region for the LOR run. Semi-scheduled generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints, and incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.
fields.name: LOR_SEMISCHEDULEDCAPACITY

fields.doc: Largest Credible Risk. MW value for highest credible contingency
fields.name: LCR

fields.doc: Two Largest Credible Risks. MW value for highest two credible contingencies.
fields.name: LCR2

fields.doc: Forecasting Uncertainty Measure. MW value of reserve calculated as defined in the Reserve Level Declaration Guidelines
fields.name: FUM

fields.doc: Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast for solar for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run, this is the POE90 forecast (determined by LRCUIGFOption in CaseSolution). For LOR run, this is the POE50 forecast.
fields.name: SS_SOLAR_UIGF

fields.doc: Unconstrained Intermittent Generation Forecast for wind for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run, this is the POE90 forecast (determined by LRCUIGFOption in CaseSolution). For LOR run, this is the POE50 forecast.
fields.name: SS_WIND_UIGF

fields.doc: Constrained generation forecast for solar for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run. solar generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All run types (OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.
fields.name: SS_SOLAR_CAPACITY

fields.doc: Constrained generation forecast for wind for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, wind generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All run types (OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits.
fields.name: SS_WIND_CAPACITY

fields.doc: Constrained generation forecast (MW) for solar for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, solar generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All run types (OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits. This value is the same as SS_SOLAR_CAPACITY.
fields.name: SS_SOLAR_CLEARED

fields.doc: Constrained generation forecast (MW) for wind for the region. For OUTAGE_LRC run and LOR run, wind generation is constrained by both System Normal and Outage constraints. All run types (OUTAGE_LRC, LOR) incorporate MAXAVAIL limits. This value is the same as SS_WIND_CAPACITY.
fields.name: SS_WIND_CLEARED

fields.doc: Regional aggregated Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) availability in MW.
fields.name: WDR_AVAILABLE

fields.doc: Regional aggregated Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) PASA availability in MW.
fields.name: WDR_PASAAVAILABLE

fields.doc: Regional aggregated Wholesale Demand Response (WDR) capacity in MW.
fields.name: WDR_CAPACITY
